content.title: SMALL SYMPTOMS, {{SIMPLE}} FIXES
facts: 1. Hiccups ----- Peanut Butter — a **thick, sticky texture** forces slower swallowing, which can interrupt the spasm reflex.
2. Bad Breath ----- Parsley — packed with **chlorophyll**, a natural compound that helps neutralize odor-causing sulfur compounds.
3. Muscle Cramps ----- Bananas — rich in **potassium**, a mineral your muscles need to contract and relax properly.
4. Bloating ----- Ginger — contains compounds that support **digestion** and may ease gas and stomach discomfort.
5. Brain Fog ----- Walnuts — a good source of **omega-3s**, linked to healthy brain function and focus.
6. Mouth Ulcers ----- Yogurt — contains **probiotics** that support a balanced mouth and gut microbiome.
7. Cold Hands & Feet ----- Spinach — high in **iron**, essential for carrying oxygen through your blood to your extremities.
8. Restless Sleep ----- Tart Cherries — one of the few natural sources of **melatonin**, the hormone that regulates sleep.
9. Headaches ----- Almonds — contain **magnesium**, a mineral often linked to fewer tension headaches.
10. Dry, Flaky Skin ----- Avocado — full of **healthy fats** that help support skin's natural moisture barrier.
